BYM4: Kari pura = holding him to be perfect, holding him to be unerring. Bhukh = the hunger of Maya. Meri = the sense of mine-ness toward Maya. Jai lahi = it is removed.
they, holding their own Guru to be unerring, go on doing the service he has enjoined, (by the grace of which, from within their minds) the hunger of Maya is removed.
He serves the Perfect True Guru, and his hunger and self-conceit are eliminated.
With the hands, he serves the Perfectly, True Guru and his hunger of self-hood is eliminated.
They serve the perfect Satiguru with their hands, by which (meri) mine-ness and (bhukh) desire may be removed.
RX02: Sabh = all. Khai = eats (spiritual food). Ghaneri = much humanity.
All the hunger of Maya of those who take the Guru's shelter is removed, and in their company much other humanity too eats the spiritual food of the Nam's simran.
The hunger of the Gursikh is totally eliminated; indeed, many others are satisfied through them.
Goes all the appetite of the Sikhs of the Guru. Rather, other feed themselves in their wake.
All the hunger of the Gursikhs has departed; behind those Gursikhs much other creation eats — that is to say, by the satsang their hunger is removed.
RXRX: Hari punnu = the good seed of the Nam's simran. Toti = lack, shortfall. Keri = of. Punn keri = of the good deed ||3||
O servant Nanak! Those men who sow the good seed of the simran of the Hari-Nam (in the field of their own heart), within them there is never any lack of this good deed. ||3||
Servant Nanak has planted the Seed of the Lord's Goodness; this Goodness of the Lord shall never be exhausted. ||3||
Servant Nanak has sown the virtue of God's Name and again, the virtue of the God's Name exhausts not.

Sri Guru Ji says: that servant who has sown the merit which is the Hari Nam in the soil of the heart — that is to say, has repeated or held it — to him, by the merit of repeating the Hari Nam, there is never any (toti) shortfall of any thing at all. ||3||
CQKF: Mani = in the mind. Vadhaia = joys, spiritual uplift, ascendancy.
Those Gursikhs who have had the darshan of the beloved Guru — in their mind there stays always an ascendant spirit.
The minds of the Gursikhs rejoice, because they have seen my True Guru, O Lord King.
Rejoicing are in the mind of the Guru-Sikhs, who have seen my True Guru, O Lord, the King.
O Ram Raje! Those who have seen my Satiguru, in the mind of those Guru's Sikhs there are congratulations at all times.
8TZC: Jinh = those who have. Gal = talk, mention. So = that man. Mitha = dear.
If any man comes and recites the talk of Parmatma's praise, then that man begins to seem dear to the Gursikhs.
If someone recites to them the story of the Lord's Name, it seems so sweet to the mind of those Gursikhs.
If some one recites to them the discourse of God's Name, he seems sweet to the mind of the Guru's disciples.
Whoever makes and recites the discourse of the Hari Nam, he seems sweet in the mind of the Gursikhs.
W3S3: Painhaiahi = robes of honour are given, they are honoured {present tense, passive voice, third person, plural}. Tutha = became pleased.
Those Gursikhs with whom the beloved Satiguru is pleased receive honour and regard in Parmatma's court.
The Gursikhs are robed in honor in the Court of the Lord; my True Guru is very pleased with them.
The Sikhs of the Guru, with whom my True Guru is mightily pleased are robed in God's court.
Those Gursikhs with whom my Satigur has been (tutha) pleased, to those Gursikhs a robe of honour is (painaiahi) put on in Hari's court — the sense being, they are treated with distinction.
3G4A: Nanaku = Nanak (says). Vutha = came to dwell ||4||12||19||
Nanak says — those Gursikhs become the very form of Parmatma; Parmatma stays for ever dwelling within their mind. ||4||12||19||
Servant Nanak has become the Lord, Har, Har; the Lord, Har, Har, abides within his mind. ||4||12||19||
Nanak, the Lord's servant, within whose mind God's Name abides, has become the Lord God Himself.
Sri Guru Ji says: that Gursikh in whose mind the Hari Hari Nam has (vutha) come to dwell, he, having (hari) renounced craving, has become the form of Hari. ||4||12||19||
AHP7: Jinha bhetia = those who took shelter. Drirhavai = makes firm within the heart.
Those men who have taken hold of the beloved Guru's hem — the Guru makes Parmatma's Nam firm within their heart.
Those who meet my Perfect True Guru - He implants within them the Name of the Lord, the Lord King.
They who meet my perfect, True Guru, within them, he establishes the Name of God, O Lord, the King.
Those to whom my perfect Satiguru has been met, to them he makes firm the Nam of Hari Ram Raje.
W8BH: Tis ki = of that (man). Trisna = thirst. Jo = which man.
That man who remembers Parmatma's Nam — all his hunger and thirst for Maya is removed.
Those who meditate on the Lord's Name have all of their desire and hunger removed.
They, who meditate on God's Name have all their desires and hungers removed.
Those who repeat the Hari Nam, all their hunger in the form of trishna is removed.
JRDL: Jo dhiaide = those men who remember. Tinh nerhi = near them.
Those men who always remember Parmatma's Nam, the jam does not come near them (spiritual death cannot exert its influence upon them).
Those who meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har - the Messenger of Death cannot even approach them.
They, who contemplate over the Name of the Lord Master, near them comes not the death's courier.
Those who meditate upon the Hari Hari Nam, near them the jam does not come.
B0LD: Kari = may He do, He does. Nami = in the Nam (having joined). Taravai = He carries across ||1||
O servant Nanak! He upon whom Parmatma shows mercy repeats His Nam always, and Parmatma, joining him to His own Nam, carries him across (the world-ocean). ||1||
O Lord, shower Your Mercy upon servant Nanak, that he may ever chant the Name of the Lord; through the Name of the Lord, he is saved. ||1||
O God, show mercy to slave Nanak, who ever remembers God's Name and who with God's Name is saved.
Sri Guru Ji says: O Hari! Show mercy upon us servants, by which we may daily repeat Your Hari Nam, and by the Hari Nam may (taravai) carry other seekers too across the ocean of the world. ||1||
5F4S: Gurmukhi = by way of the Guru. Bighanu = obstacle. Sad = always. Purakhu = the great being, the one possessed of capability.
Those men who, taking the Guru's shelter, remember Parmatma's Nam — no obstacle (of the vices and the rest) comes again in their journey of life.
Those who, as Gurmukh, meditate on the Naam, meet no obstacles in their path, O Lord King.
They, who, through the Guru, remember the Name, no more meet obstacle, in the way.
Those who have meditated upon the Nam of Ram Raje by way of the Gurus, to them no obstacle of any kind comes again.
61R0: Puje = does honour. Sabhu koi = every being.
Those men who (having made their own life pure) win the pleasure of the Guru possessed of capability — every being does them honour and regard.
Those who are pleasing to the almighty True Guru are worshipped by everyone.
They, who propitiate their potent True Guru, them worships the whole world.
Those who have won over and pleased the Satigur Purakh — everyone, that is to say the whole world, performs their worship.
DJXD: Those men who perform the seva enjoined by the beloved Guru (who take the Guru's support) obtain spiritual bliss for ever.
Those who serve their Beloved True Guru obtain eternal peace.
They, who serve their beloved True Guru, ever obtain peace.
Those who have served the beloved Satigur, to them happiness has come for all time.
3MWN: Nanaku = Nanak (says). Bhetia = took shelter, took hold of the hem. Soi = He Himself ||2||
Nanak (says) — those men who take hold of the Guru's hem, to them Parmatma comes and is met of Himself. ||2||
Those who meet the True Guru, O Nanak - the Lord Himself meets them. ||2||
Those who meet Nanak, the True Guru, them, He, the Lord meets.
Sri Guru Ji says: those to whom the Satiguru has been met, to them that Hari has been met. ||2||
8QNY: Antari = in the heart. Gurmukhi = by walking the road the Guru showed. Rakhanhara = possessed of the power to save.
Those men within whose heart the love of Parmatma arises by walking the road the Guru showed — Parmatma, who has the power to save, (saves them from the vices).
Those Gurmukhs, who are filled with His Love, have the Lord as their Saving Grace, O Lord King.
The Guru-wards, within whose mind is the Lord's love, their saviour is God Master, the Monarch.
Those gurmukhs within whom is the love of Hari Ram Raje, of them Hari is the protector.
BY0B: Kia kare = what can he do? He cannot do it (because no vice remains in them that could be reviled).
Those men to whom Parmatma's Nam begins to seem dear — no one can slander them, because no blameworthy fault remains in their life at all.
How can anyone slander them? The Lord's Name is dear to them.
How can any one slander them, to whom God's Name is dear?
Those to whom the Hari-Nam seems dear — what will anyone's slander of them do? The sense being, their slanderer can spoil nothing at all.
JRFY: Seti = with. Mania = became satisfied, grew accustomed. Dusat = evil men. Jhakh = vain effort.
So, those whose mind grows accustomed to Parmatma — evil men beat about in vain (to defame them).
Those whose minds are in harmony with the Lord - all their enemies attack them in vain.
They, whose soul is reconciled (intimate) with God, all the miscreants, traduce them in vain.

Those whose mind has been satisfied with Hari — that is to say, has become established in Hari — all the wicked have beaten about in vain to make obstruction in their work, but nothing at all comes of anyone's saying.
9GDB: O servant Nanak! (Say —) Those men who remember the Hari-Nam, Hari who has the power to save (saves them from the vices). ||3||
Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Lord Protector. ||3||
Servant Nanak has contemplated upon the Name of God, who is the Saviour of all.
Sri Guru Ji says: those who have meditated upon the Nam, of them Hari has become the protector. ||3||
W8FD: Jugu jugu = in every age {see 'Gurbani Viakaran'}. Upaia = goes on creating. Paij = honour. Dei = having given.
Parmatma creates bhagats in every single age, and (in times of hardship) has gone on keeping their honour.
In each and every age, He creates His devotees and preserves their honor, O Lord King.
In every age God created His saints and preserved their honour.
O Hari Ram Raje! You have brought forth bhagats in all four ages, and again You have gone on keeping the bhagats' pledge.
90T1: (As, for instance, Prahilad's cruel father) the wicked Harnakhas Parmatma (in the end) slew, and rescued (His own bhagat) Prahilad safe and sound (from the torments given by his father).
The Lord killed the wicked Harnaakhash, and saved Prahlaad.
Wicked Harnakhsh, the Lord killed and saved Prehlad.
O Hari! You slew the wicked Harnakhyash, and again You ferried Prahilad across the ocean of the world.
DKY1: Mukhi laia = took to His own face, gave honour and regard, bestowed dignity. Aisa = of such capability.
(As, for instance,) to the slanderers and the (caste-) proud (who pushed him from the temple, Parmatma) turned His back, and gave His darshan to (His own bhagat) Namdev.
He turned his back on the egotists and slanderers, and showed His Face to Naam Dayv.
On the egotists and slanderers, the Lord turned His back and to Namdev, He showed His face (affection).
Turning His back on the proud, slandering brahmans, O Hari, You turned the temple around for Namdev and took him to Your own face.
UXJK: O servant Nanak! Whatever man performs the seva and bhagti of a Parmatma of such capability, Parmatma in the end rescues him (from all the torments inflicted by ill-wishers). ||4||13||20||
Servant Nanak has so served the Lord, that He will deliver him in the end. ||4||13||20||
Servant Nanak has so served His God, that He will deliver him in the end.

Sri Guru Ji says: O Hari! We servants have served such a You — that in the end You may release us from sorrows on every side. ||4||13||20|| ☬ Making his love manifest, he gives the updesh addressed to his own mind:
